name: Telegram
summary: Chat with Pilot from your phone.

steps.title: Open BotFather
steps.text: Open Telegram on your phone or computer and search for BotFather. Pick the one with the blue check mark, then tap Start.

steps.title: Make your bot
steps.text: Send /newbot to BotFather. It asks for a name (anything, like My Pilot) and then a username that must end in bot (like mypilot123_bot).

steps.title: Copy the token
steps.text: BotFather replies with a token that looks like 123456789:ABCdef... Copy all of it. Keep it private, like a password.

steps.title: Paste it here
steps.text: Click Paste below to put the token in the box.

steps.title: Say hi to your bot
steps.text: In Telegram, open the link BotFather gave you (t.me/ and your bot's username), tap Start and send any message. Then press Test connection here.

privacy: Messages to your bot travel through Telegram's servers. Pilot answers only you: the person who messages the bot during setup. Pilot can answer while it is open on your computer.
connected_text: Message your bot on Telegram and Pilot will answer.
